==Description==
This template is used for creating the blue "archive box" used for closed [[Wookieepedia:Wookieepedian of the Month|Wookieepedian of the Month]] votes.

==Usage==
The template takes one optional signature parameter. Place the following code at the top of the vote page to be archived:
<pre>
{{subst:WotMarchive|~~~~}}
</pre>

Then, to avoid disrupting the page layout, add this closing tag at the very end of the thread:
<pre>
</div>
</pre>

*[[:Category:Wookieepedia Wookieepedian of the Month archive pages]]
